description: This file defines the BatchScanExec class, a physical plan node for scanning data from a data source v2 in Apache Spark. It manages input partitions, runtime filtering, partitioning, and data reading logic.

classes.name: BatchScanExec
classes.description: A physical plan node for executing batch scans from a data source v2, supporting runtime filtering, partitioning, and data reading.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on batch, runtime filters, and spjParams.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on batch and runtime filters.

methods.name: outputPartitioning
methods.description: Returns the output partitioning, possibly adjusted for key grouping.

methods.name: doCanonicalize
methods.description: Returns a canonical form of the plan with normalized expressions and predicates.

methods.name: simpleString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the plan with limited detail.

methods.name: nodeName
methods.description: Returns the node name string for this plan node.
